findings.title: Measured creation and governing order
findings.claim: The focus can be read as a measured, staged act of bringing the cosmos into being followed by throne-governance; 13:2 repeats the throne formula and places celestial courses and management of the affair after it.
findings.mechanism: The focus's six counted periods and delayed thumma make creation a bounded course before istawa and al-arsh. The 41:9/12 creation account supplies a separate numbered sequence, while 13:2 repeats the throne construction and then names the sun and moon's appointed course and management of the affair. These contacts let the focus's making and governing clauses explain one another as an ordered act and its administration.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see creation and rule as one connected sequence whose ordering continues in governance.
findings.containment: This reading adds a possible relation to the ordinary claim that God created the heavens, earth, and what lies between and established over the Throne. The wider verses are supplied as exact Arabic without target morphology; the parallel does not establish a physical model of the Throne. A reciprocal connection note treats 13:2 as repeating creation and throne without adding this focus's administration, so that counter-reading remains open.

epistemic.reason: A trusted focus publication supplies the six branch claim; the represented reader trace is legacy_unbound, and the external connection rows provide surface Arabic without target morphology.

findings.title: No independent protector or intercessor

In 10:3 the throne-and-management account is followed by a no-intercessor-except-after-permission statement; 32:5 describes the affair moving down from heaven to earth and returning. These triggers contact the focus's other-than, charge, and advocacy branches and make independence, rather than every mediated act, the relevant boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold together the force of the paired denial and the possibility that any mediation remains dependent on the same governing source.
findings.containment: The focus still denies a wali and shafii besides Him. The wider permission statement does not insert an exception into its wording or decide how every kind of mediated act functions. Target morphology for 10:3 is not supplied, and the delegated-agency traces remain legacy-attributed.

findings.mechanism: The focus HFT trace maps creation to a water-holding hollow, sky to first rain, between to a connecting channel, and throne to a raised well platform. The independent 32:27 flow-and-yield scene supplies movement, medium, and output, contacting those carriers and changing a static cosmic image into an imagined route of gathering and delivery.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can picture the surprising reading as a system image, with an upper input, a route, and visible yield below.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory analogy assembled from legacy-attributed root images. The form of khalaqa is a finite creation verb, so the hollow is not its lexical translation; the reading makes no physical claim about cosmography or the real nature of the Throne.

epistemic.reason: The reading is a multi-step HFT outlier with exact supplied 32:27 Arabic but no independent context morphology or bound reader identity.

friction_notes: The no-proxy/faculties trace infers nondelegable responsibility; the supplied reader inference also allows that hearing, sight, and inward discernment may more narrowly ground gratitude.
The delegated-agency trace supports command-bound agents, while its own stricter alternative says such agents may lack usable guardianship or intercession without explicit authorization.

The spatial, judicial, and ecological functions of between may remain distinct resonances rather than one integrated mechanism; the water route may share endpoints with administration without literally enacting it.
The duna hierarchy reading remains alongside the ordinary other-than reading; 32:21 does not force the focus phrase to mean inferior or short of the goal.
The embodied remembrance fork may be a general exemplification of response rather than a single chronological account of the focus's hearers.
The opening-day reading does not prove that the focus names that day, and the focus's remembrance word does not lexically mean opening.
The exact 22:47 comparison reopens temporal scale but does not equate the six focus periods with a thousand years or specify their duration.
The wellwork and double-vision outliers remain analogical images, not translations or physical claims.
The 13:2 reciprocal nomination treats its throne parallel as repeating the focus without adding the focus's administration; that counter-reading remains open beside the focus-direction reading.
